mechanism: row-to-core balance / per-stripe row-group owner mirror
hypothesis: Mirroring logical row-group owners on odd full stripes may alter physical-block to row-band ownership phase across successive stripes while preserving exact per-block row work.
change: In GetGroupedStripeRow for full stripes, compute stripeGroup = ordinal / groupWidth; even stripeGroup values retain logicalBlockIdx ownership and odd stripeGroup values use blockCount - 1 - logicalBlockIdx. Tail row mapping is unchanged.

distinction_check.evidence: For blockCount=4 and groupWidth=2, logical block 0 owns baseline rows [0,1,8,9] across two full stripes and R045 rows [0,1,14,15]. R044 only changes visit order and leaves owner sets unchanged; R043 changes only sparse-tail owners; R041 uses one static physical/logical block mapping. No prior N10 result record describes alternating full-stripe owner sets.
distinction_check.scope_note: This is a changed row-ownership set, not a batch traversal permutation.

ownership_validation.command: inline python3 -c enumeration of blockCount 1..24, groupWidth 1..6, fullGroups 0..4, and every possible tail length
invariants: Every row is assigned exactly once across full stripes and the tail.
Per-block total row counts differ by at most one.
Every full stripe assigns exactly one groupWidth-sized row group to each logical block.
ownership_validation.scope_note: Static ownership validation only; not runtime correctness, performance, or Core-utilization validation.

scope_check.details: Only full-stripe logical block ownership of row groups alternates by stripe parity. Row group size, row counts, all tail ownership, rowOffset = sourceRow * rowWidth, output row stride, GM transaction sizes, arithmetic, UB buffers, reduction topology, and traversal order are otherwise unchanged.
